verdict.rationale: A machine-readable API description (OpenAPI or an equivalent such as a structured API reference) is a fair axis for a library ecosystem, so the axis applies. The evidence shows no such spec: every probed OpenAPI/Swagger path returned 404, and the llms.txt and llms-full.txt files are prose documentation, not a structured API spec. The @types/three typings mentioned by the community are described as not maintained by the project, so they are not a first-party capability and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
